defect.title: Liability is not capped
defect.grade_reason: computed from the contract's own terms; every supporting clause was located in this document, and confirmed against the clause text on a second, independent reading
defect.explanation: The document states no ceiling on either party's total liability, and it imposes 15 duties whose breach it attaches no consequence to at all — no sum, no remedy, no cap. defect.title: Modification right directly conflicts with modification ban
defect.grade_reason: reported by the previous analysis of this document; this run's checks did not raise it again, and it is kept because a re-reading of the clauses as they now stand still supports it. Confirm it against the current draft
defect.explanation: Clause 1.3 expressly entitles the Licensee to modify and adapt the Software, while subclause 2.2.5 strictly prohibits the Licensee from carrying out modification, adaptation, or other interference with the structure of the Software. These provisions cannot both hold simultaneously because one grants a right that the other categorically forbids, and neither is drafted as an exception to the other. If Vantage Cognition Kazakhstan guesses wrong and modifies the Software, it faces breach-of-contract liability to Vantage Cognition, Inc.; if it forgoes modification, it loses a commercially valuable grant it was promised.

evidence.quote: The Licensee is entitled to freely integrate the Software, as well as to modify and adapt it, to the extent not contrary to this Agreement.

Not to carry out decompilation, disassembly, reverse engineering, modification, adaptation, or other interference with the structure of the Software, except where expressly permitted by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

defect.suggested_fix: Amend subclause 2.2.5 to state that the prohibition on modification and adaptation does not apply to modifications expressly permitted under Clause 1.3, or alternatively narrow Clause 1.3 to permit only integration while retaining the modification ban.

llm_verdict.short_reason: §1.3 grants the Licensee the right 'to modify and adapt' the Software while §2.2.5 prohibits 'modification, adaptation' except where permitted by law, and the carve-outs do not reconcile the two provisions.

verification.reason: §1.3 grants the Licensee the right 'to modify and adapt' the Software while §2.2.5 prohibits 'modification, adaptation' except where permitted by law, and the carve-outs do not reconcile the two provisions.
